_why: Tail family for ISCO minor group 817 (Wood and Paper Plant). Bound at MINOR level (specificity 30) rather than per unit group: the 817x units are narrow industrial specialisations whose workers would get near-identical questions, and 158 near-duplicate packs would be padding that LOOKS like coverage. A unit-level family always wins over this one — that is what the six specificity levels are for.
_v2: REMOVES `tools_owned`. A plant operator runs the employer's plant; nobody brings their own furnace, extruder or loom. The ownership question is meaningless here and the machine question beside it already carries the real signal. Phase 6 (#615) stamped one shared block onto every cluster it could not differentiate; this is the row that block got wrong.
review_note: v2 removes tools_owned (plant cluster). v1 is deprecated in the same commit — the corpus validator refuses a second ACTIVE pack for one family+locale, because the resolver must never have to choose.
